turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What's a good first dance song that isn't super cheesy?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It depends on your taste. Something like an old soul ballad or an acoustic cover of a song you both love tends to feel personal without being cheesy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We met at a jazz bar, if that helps.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh, then a jazz standard would be perfect. Something slow and swingy, maybe even played by a live trio.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hmm, I believe it is. Which part doesn't sound right?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A live band sounds expensive though

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: how much do they usually cost?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A small jazz trio often runs between one and three thousand dollars for an evening, depending on the city.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, that's too much. We'll just play a recording.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Totally fine. Ask your DJ to fade it out after two minutes so nobody feels stuck on the floor.
